verdict_basis: Values accepted: ~2 px boundary offsets at 90/120 min and sub-1 mM late segments at the resolution limit (see checks); plus the documentation flag on conditions.notes (see issues).
independence: Verifier extracted the embedded raster itself (pymupdf, native resolution), located tick marks with its own code, and re-read every value with its own reader (per-row nearest-prototype colour classification of two side strips per bar, error-bar green and white hatch excluded, monotone DP over the legend stacking order; markers by colour masks + morphological opening). Extractor scripts and readings were not used.

fixes_applied.change: meta.json conditions.notes: the ~50 mA cm-2 (0.204 A) current and the cathode-loop pH 12.65 / trap-tank pH 1.53 are now attributed to the Fig. 2e run (25 mM, pH 7) and stated as not reported for this run; added the derived total current density for this run, about 89 mA cm-2 (88.6) = jNH3 / FE_TAN from gao2022_fig3b_eff_vs_condition/extracted.csv, labelled as derived; the volume_mL sentence now says 50 mL is stated only for the Fig. 2e run and assumed here; removed the duplicate 'Feed volume ... assumed' sentence. data/real regenerated with scripts/digitized_to_dataset.py (conditions.notes only; series unchanged).

Powered-window cut (coordinator request): the unchanged 0-480 min digitization was copied byte-identically to wpd_datasets_full_0-480min.csv, and wpd_datasets.csv now holds only t <= 300 min (11 of 17 sampling times, original values, nothing re-read), so the converted dataset matches potential_mode 'potentiostatic'. DC-off time established from the figure (no switch time in the text for this run): In Fig. S15c the green 'Electricity turn on' / lavender 'Electricity turn off' shading boundary sits midway between the 300 and 330 min bars (pixel measurement on the native SI image: x = 766.5 px, 0.49 of the bar-centre gap), so the last DC-on sample is 300 min and the switch fell between 300 and 330 min. The S15a panel (25 mM) is the Fig. 2e run, which the text says was switched off after 120 min; its shading boundary is drawn the same way (0.49 of the 120-150 min gap). Derived corroboration: the text's NO3- removal rate at 150 mM (1258 +/- 39 g-N m-2 d-1) equals 150 mM x 50 mL removed over 301 min (292-310 min across the stated range) on 4 cm2, consistent with normalization over the 300-min DC-on window and with the assumed 50 mL feed. meta.json: conditions.notes records the window, the full-series path and how the DC-off time was established; provenance.figure notes the window; n_basis_note says no equivalent of the Fig. 2e 1.05 mmol check exists for this run (molar NH3 amount stated only for Fig. 2e); provenance.notes marks post-window statements as referring to the full file. data/real/gao2022_figs15c_cuo_150mM.json regenerated: series, reported_n_loss and n_closure now end at 300 min.

checks.name: thin_late_segments
checks.detail: Verifier auto-reader missed the 450-min and 480-min 'TAN in reaction chamber' slivers (read 0) and the 240-min NO3- sliver (read 0) because the 1-2 anti-aliased rows above the axis line are excluded. Manual row profiles: 450 min has 3 light-orange rows above the axis (2142-2144) -> ~1.2-1.4 mM, supporting the stored 1.337; 420 min has 6 rows -> 2.6 mM (stored 2.885); 480 min shows no distinct segment (stored 0.718 = 2.3 px incl. axis overlap, at the resolution limit); 240 min shows a 1-px blue strip with an NO3- error-bar cap (stored 0.718 plausible).

checks.name: boundaries_90_120_min
checks.detail: At 90 and 120 min the stored NO2-/N2 boundary sits ~2 px (0.6 mM) above the visible boundary (row profile at x=346: N2 ends at row 1736.5, stored cumulative implies 1734.6), and at 90 min the reaction/trap boundary sits ~2 px low. Affects NO2-, N2 and TAN splits by ~0.6 mM (0.4 % of axis); within the extractor's stated +/-1-2 px but at its edge.

checks.name: pH7_25mM_is_fig2e_run
checks.detail: Verifier read S14c and S15a with the same reader: all 65 segment values agree within 0.09 mM, so the pH 7 / 25 mM panels are the same plotted run (consistent with not writing them separately).
